summary: The milestone completed 10 experiments in 40.2 minutes, including 7 compute-bound experiments. Fresh SOTA fixed-policy candidate corpus took 33.56 minutes and dominated the recorded execution tail, but the supplied data does not identify the cause of that duration.
bottlenecks_identified: Among the displayed compute-bound rows, Fresh SOTA fixed-policy candidate corpus took 33.56 minutes, Prospective verifier-bounded factor-weight continuous self-learning took 1.6 minutes, Gated on Exp6455 CSL readiness: corrupt-feedback quarantine and held restart rep took 1.48 minutes, and Independent verifier-bounded CSL row and lifecycle audit took 0.21 minutes. No phase data is available to explain these durations.

The GPU snapshot is not linked to an experiment interval. The locked task-level field does not flag GPU idle on compute-bound work, so the snapshot cannot establish inefficient compute-task utilization.
The data does not state whether any compute-bound task loaded multiple models concurrently or which runner it selected. A missed DualGPURunner engagement therefore cannot be identified.
improvements_suggested: Emit task-scoped phase timing and GPU samples for every compute-bound experiment, with special attention to the fixed-policy corpus path.
Record model concurrency and runner selection in each compute receipt; select DualGPURunner only for declared concurrent multi-model work.
Add readiness-aware scheduling that assigns independent compute-bound experiments across the available GPUs and preserves single-GPU execution for single-model work.
Add checkpoints and long-stage alerts to the corpus workflow after phase telemetry identifies the stage that dominates its elapsed time.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the fixed-policy corpus workflow with phase clocks and task-correlated GPU samples.
Schedule independent compute-bound experiments across the available GPUs when their readiness gates permit overlap.
Require model-count and runner-selection receipts so DualGPURunner eligibility and engagement are auditable.
meta_reflection: The available records support an elapsed-time ranking, but they do not support a causal explanation, a compute-period GPU efficiency grade, or a DualGPURunner failure finding. The estimated saving remains unquantified at 0 percent because the supplied data contains no measured alternative run.
